C1542.title: aBNBc Token Infinite Minting Vulnerability Incident
C1542.summary: In December 2022, an infinite minting vulnerability was discovered in the aBNBc token contract of the DeFi protocol Ankr. The security team PeckShield noted that the attacker exploited a specific function flaw to mint unlimited aBNBc tokens, causing the token price to nearly zero, and the attacker profited approximately $15 million through arbitrage.
